statement: Let a subarray nums[i..j] (with 0 <= i <= j < len(nums)) be called valid for limit when |nums[p]-nums[q]| <= limit for every p,q with i <= p <= j and i <= q <= j. The function returns a result r, and r is the largest integer L such that L = j-i+1 for some valid subarray nums[i..j].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000; 0 <= limit <= 1000000000.
